notes.title: Soundtrack Vol. 2 Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Make sure to update your copy of Death Goat for performance improvements, bug fixes and best of all, NEW METAL!

Here's the rundown:

- Improved controller detection
- Added fullscreen / windowed toggle to the settings screen
- The game will now work on both 32-bit and 64-bit Windows
- Fixed occasional input problems when triggering bombs
- Fixed game music not automatically switching to the next track when the
current one finished
- Fixed wrong UI label when choosing the track in the selection screen
- Updated Unity and all the third-party middleware for general performance improvements

New Music:

Aegaeon - The Integral Path 
Brutai - Deep 
Kardashev - Lucido 
Dawn Of Leviathan - Adrift With Knowledge 
Extinction Level Event - Entropy 
Mare Cognitum - Entropic Hallucinations 
NYN - Torrential Flames

Soundtrack Vol. 2 available here - http://store.steampowered.com/app/444780/

Enjoy the new content while we start working on the first set of gameplay updates & additions that will be coming to you soon \m/

notes.title: Player Feedback Update
notes.notes:
Based upon your feedback, we've released a quick update to include the following:

- Added menu option to disable gamepad vibration
- Reduced size of the in-game score UI
- Added custom mouse cursor
- Death Tank Balancing
- Added current progress towards unlocking the Death Tank to the selection screen

New music is on the way soon as we continue to support and build upon our unholy beast \m/
